rights: Right to receive salary on time every month
Right to claim full salary for days worked
Right to be informed of any deductions
steps: Send a formal email to HR and your manager
Send a legal notice via a lawyer if there is no response
File a complaint with the Labor Commissioner's office
Approach the Labor Court if the matter is not resolved

rights: Right to a notice period or salary in lieu of notice
Right to know the reason for termination
Right to a fair hearing before being fired
steps: Review your employment contract for termination clauses
Request a written explanation for the termination
File a dispute with the local Labor Department
Seek reinstatement or compensation through Labor Court

rights: Right to receive double the normal hourly rate for overtime
Right to refuse excessive working hours beyond legal limits
Right to documented records of overtime hours worked
steps: Maintain a personal log of daily entry and exit times
Submit a written request for overtime payment to the accounts department
Report the violation to the Factory Inspector or Labor Inspector
File a claim for unpaid wages under the Payment of Wages Act
documents: Work logs or project completion emails

rights: Right to stay in the property until the legal notice period ends
Right to be protected from forceful or physical eviction
Right to basic amenities like water and electricity
steps: Check if the eviction notice complies with the rent agreement
Reply to the eviction notice through a legal counsel
File for an injunction in Civil Court to prevent forceful eviction
Lodge a police complaint if the landlord cuts off utilities

rights: Right to receive the security deposit back within the agreed timeframe
Right to a transparent list of deductions for repairs
Right to full refund if no damage is caused to the property
steps: Take photos of the house condition when vacating
Request a final walkthrough with the landlord
Send a written demand for the refund of the deposit
File a case in the Small Causes Court or with the Rent Authority
documents: Security deposit receipt or bank transfer proof

rights: Right to pay only the rent agreed upon in the contract
Right to receive a receipt for every rent payment
Right to fair rent as determined by the Rent Controller
steps: Communicate with the landlord to resolve the disagreement
Deposit the rent with the Rent Controller if the landlord refuses to accept it
Apply for 'Fair Rent' fixing through the local Rent Authority
Keep records of all previous rent increases and payments
documents: Market rate proof of similar properties

rights: Right to receive a product that is safe and functional
Right to a replacement for a manufacturing defect
Right to be protected against deceptive marketing
steps: Contact the customer care of the brand immediately
Register a complaint on the National Consumer Helpline
Send a formal notice to the seller and manufacturer
File a petition in the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
documents: Photos or videos of the defect

rights: Right to a full refund if a service is not provided
Right to a refund if an order is cancelled by the seller
Right to receive the refund within a reasonable time
steps: Check the refund policy of the website or store
Send a written request for a refund with the order details
File a chargeback request with your bank if paid by card
File a case in Consumer Court if the amount is high

rights: Right to free repairs during the warranty period
Right to extension of warranty if the product is in repair for long
Right to free replacement if the product cannot be repaired
steps: Visit an authorized service center with the warranty card
Obtain a job sheet or service report from the center
Escalate the issue to the company's nodal officer
File a complaint for 'unfair trade practice' in Consumer Court
documents: Photos of the product serial number
